verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is that Workable's MCP server covers the hiring lifecycle 'through offer approvals' (workable-docs-4), which implies an offer-approval workflow exists. A requisitions endpoint exists (workable-docs-29), but nothing describes requisitions or job openings needing approval before going live. Missing for 10: documentation of configurable multi-step approval chains, job-opening/requisition approval before publishing, a guarantee that offers can't be sent until approved, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
